gothic_fantasy_castles.label: 고딕 성채 · 어두운 중세 판타지
gothic_fantasy_castles.direction: Curate beautiful but buildable medieval Gothic castles for a dark-fantasy game's environment art. Blend historically grounded 12th–15th-century stone fortifications with lofty Gothic ecclesiastical architecture. Favor strong, readable silhouettes, convincing structural logic, modular asset references, and evocative cold-weather ambience. Fantasy must be subtle and architectural rather than supernatural; a real castle is a good reference even without fantastical elements. Favor varied image compositions rather than three nearly identical distant castle views.
gothic_fantasy_castles.period: High/Late Medieval Western & Central Europe, circa 1200–1500; castles, abbeys, fortified Gothic estates
gothic_fantasy_castles.architecture: Massive gatehouses, curtain walls and crenellations; narrow lancet windows and pointed arches; slender towers and buttresses; vaulted passages; believable elevated foundations and rooflines. Emphasize coherent, varied vertical silhouettes and stone structural logic.
gothic_fantasy_castles.materials: Aged limestone, granite and sandstone masonry, damp weathering, chipped edges, moss, dark slate roofs, wrought iron, timber gates; modular wall blocks and ornamental tracery.
gothic_fantasy_castles.lighting: Cloudy late afternoon, dawn mist, fog in valleys, wet stone and soft directional light; occasional warm windows for contrast, never overwhelming magical glow.
gothic_fantasy_castles.palette: Desaturated cold gray, charcoal, moss green, faded slate blue, pale mist, tiny accents of muted warm amber.

eightbit_fx.label: 8비트 이펙트 · 픽셀아트 · 게임 VFX
eightbit_fx.direction: Curate highly readable 8-bit, pixel-art and retro-styled GAME VFX references. Prioritize effects actually useful for game production: hit sparks, melee slashes, impact flashes, explosions, smoke puffs, projectiles, magic bursts, fire, lightning, wind, water, healing, status effects and UI feedback. Find pixel-art sprite sheets, frame-by-frame animation breakdowns, VFX showcases and gameplay examples where the effect itself is the clear subject. Both authentic limited-palette console-era visuals and modern stylized pixel-art effects are welcome. Favor distinct effect shapes and timing references over generic pixel characters or environments.
eightbit_fx.period: Authentic 8-bit and 16-bit console/handheld game aesthetics, modern pixel-art action and RPG games, retro fantasy or science fiction. Any period or setting is allowed when pixel-art VFX are the focus.
eightbit_fx.architecture: Visual effect construction: sprite-sheet rows and columns, frame-by-frame poses, silhouette evolution, anticipation/impact/recovery timing, pixel clusters, limited-color palette ramping, staggered effect layers, trails, hit stop, additive-looking flashes, animation loops and gameplay readability. 'Architecture' means effect structure, not buildings.
eightbit_fx.materials: Crisp pixel clusters, sharp silhouettes, animated spark pixels, explosion rings, smoke puffs, elemental projectiles, magic particles, sword slash arcs, lightning bolts, dust impacts and stylized glow simulated with palette clusters or layered pixel sprites.
eightbit_fx.lighting: High contrast, readable bright-on-dark flashes and clear effect silhouettes. Limited-palette highlights and strong primary/secondary colors are welcome, but avoid blurry smoothing that hides pixel structure.
eightbit_fx.palette: Any coherent retro or retro-inspired palette: limited NES or Game Boy colors, warm arcade hit sparks, rich modern pixel RPG effects, neon accents and expressive elemental palettes.

roles.silhouette: Prioritize an unmistakable pixel-art effect shape: hit spark, explosion bloom, curved slash, projectile trail, burst ring, lightning strike, smoke cloud, healing aura or spell impact. The effect must be readable in a single still frame.
roles.architecture: Prioritize production-useful pixel effect sprite sheets, animation frame sequences, step-by-step effect breakdowns, layer construction and color palettes. Look for clear key frames and the visual logic of anticipation, impact and decay.
roles.atmosphere: Prioritize expressive retro-game energy through clean pixel color, rhythm and contrast: bright arcade impacts, magical sparkles, dark curse smoke, elemental casts and dramatic RPG battle effects. The pixel effect itself must remain central.

moody_painterly_3d_rendering.label: 어두운 시네마틱 · 회화적 3D 렌더링
moody_painterly_3d_rendering.direction: Curate distinctive STYLIZED 3D ENVIRONMENT RENDERS that feel like a dark painterly cinematic illustration. The reference mood is a storm-darkened naval diorama on a nearly black sea: high three-quarter camera, large readable simplified forms, cold charcoal and slate-blue colors, layered atmospheric haze, speckled sea spray, soft painterly textures and restrained wet highlights. This is a RENDERING/ART-DIRECTION topic, not a request for aircraft carriers. Include varied environments such as coastal/industrial architecture, islands, urban ruins, vehicles in environments, fantasy landscapes and sci-fi sets when they share this treatment. Prioritize finished 3D artwork, lighting studies, look-development breakdowns and environment art portfolios. The scene should remain legible in spite of dramatic darkness. Seek style and technique, not recurring copies of the same subject.
moody_painterly_3d_rendering.period: Any era or genre: contemporary industrial, historical, naval, fantasy or subtle sci-fi. Subject is secondary to the painterly stylized 3D rendering approach.
moody_painterly_3d_rendering.architecture: Strong, blocky but carefully art-directed silhouettes; modular architectural or vehicle shapes; readable planes; miniature/diorama-like composition; elevated three-quarter camera, wide cinematic framing and depth layering. Painterly concept-art finish over simplified 3D geometry, without plastic toy proportions.
moody_painterly_3d_rendering.materials: Hand-painted or painterly PBR materials, soft rough surfaces, selectively wet reflective edges, distressed metal or concrete, rock and dark ocean, textured brush-stroke breakup, subtle grunge, atmospheric particles and spindrift. Detail should support broad shapes rather than compete with them.
moody_painterly_3d_rendering.lighting: Very low-key cinematic lighting; cloudy dusk, storm, twilight or night; diffuse cool ambient bounce; soft directional highlights and deep near-black shadows; volumetric fog, sea spray or drifting particles; localized pale highlights and tiny warm light accents for readable depth.
moody_painterly_3d_rendering.palette: Very restrained desaturated charcoal, near-black navy, blue-gray, steel/slate gray, muted teal and a little pale mist-gray; sparse washed-out amber or cream highlights. No saturated cyan, purple, candy colors or intense bloom.

roles.silhouette: Choose a finished stylized 3D environment render with a clear three-quarter or wide cinematic composition. Assess chunky simplified forms, subject/environment scale, negative space, focal placement and strong layered dark silhouettes. Do not require naval imagery.
roles.architecture: Choose production-useful art direction or a 3D lighting/material breakdown: hand-painted surface response, simplified geometry, fog layers, restrained specular reflection, particles or scene construction. It must visibly share the dark painterly visual language.
roles.atmosphere: Choose a compelling complete 3D scene dominated by subtle cool blue-gray or charcoal tones, twilight/storm lighting, fog or mist, cinematic contrast and deep but readable shadows. Prefer emotional atmosphere over subject identity.
